_comment: Mutation-score floors (#532). Up-only under test:ratchet. Seeded ~2–3pt below measured Stryker on property-defended mutate sets (2026-07-23/24): vault custody 100%; client intents+payload-hash ~73.5%; automation scheduler ~82%; blob-format CBSF 100%; protocol judge ~76.3%; tunnel pure wire ~81.5%; app-engine cost formula 100%. Re-seeded 2026-07-31 (#656 Layer 1C): backup 97.09% measured locally after the WAL-addressing + seal/derive mutation-kill campaign (was 46.07%, below _absoluteWeaknessBelow); gateway allowed-hosts 78.79% and agent-runtime low-priority 91.89% taken from the last green nightly mutation lane (e2e.yml run 30524995032, 2026-07-30T08:10Z), replacing the conservative #545 D6 placeholders. Ratcheted 2026-07-31 (#656 Layer 3) to (measured − 2/3) against that same nightly run: protocol 85.71 → 83, tunnel 81.48 → 79, automation 83.84 → 81, client-replica 74.14 → 72. vault / blob-format / app-engine measured 100 and their 97 floors are already (measured − 3), so they are unchanged. #656 CORRECTION (2026-07-31, PR #661 CI run 30616999454): packages/backup and packages/blueprints were first seeded from LOCAL Stryker runs (97.09 and 88.52) and CI measured 85.47 and 77.46 — an ~11pt gap in both. Local darwin/arm64 and CI linux/x64 do not agree on these two mutate sets, so the floor is re-seeded ~3pt under the CI number, because CI is the lane that enforces it. Seeding from the developer's own machine is precisely the author-asserted claim this issue exists to eliminate.
_layer3Comment: #656 Layer 3 extended the adversary from 10 seeds to 15. Each new floor is (first measured − 2/3) AFTER the laws in that package's *-properties / *-contract test file landed; the score before those laws is recorded too, because the gap is the finding: blueprints 56.97 → 88.52 (floor 86); time-engine 57.90 → 77.87 (floor 75); cli 61.69 → 92.21 (floor 90); design-tokens 0.00 → 96.00 (floor 93 — the 0.00 is literal: the only css test called toCss() at module scope, and `ignoreStatic` discards static mutants, so the generator contributed zero mutants to measure); oauth-worker 57.75 → 90.85 (floor 88, pure fail-closed guard line range only). #725 adds seed 16: packages/model-runtime (named enrichment-service until #753 renamed it) tokenizer/CTC/NMS pure math measured 83.00 locally, floor 80 (measured − 3). Mutate paths and the reasoning for what was left out live in each package's stryker.config.mjs.
_w2Comment: #839 W2-1 extends the adversary from 16 seeds to 24, over the blueprint APP layer (tasks / notes / agenda / _shared pending-overlay, selection, triage, search-scaffold) and the phone (apps/mobile src/lib). EVERY FLOOR ADDED BY THIS CHANGE IS PROVISIONAL-LOCAL: it was seeded from a LOCAL linux/x64 Stryker run and NOT from CI, which this file's header says is the only lane a floor may be seeded from. To stay honest about that, each provisional floor is (local measured − 11) rather than the usual (measured − 2/3) — 11 points is the local/CI gap #656 measured on packages/backup and packages/blueprints, applied in the pessimistic direction because the direction of that gap was never verified. Re-seed each of these to (CI measured − 3) on the first green nightly mutation lane that includes them, and delete this note when that happens. Local measurements (2026-08-21, node 24 linux/x64): tasks 72.31 → 61; notes 72.18 → 61; agenda 85.52 → 74; pending-overlay 96.79 → 85; selection 76.42 → 65; triage 73.08 → 62; search-scaffold 95.65 → 84; mobile 73.00 → 62. Two of those numbers are the finding rather than the baseline: pending-overlay measured 48.23 against its existing suite alone — below _absoluteWeaknessBelow — and reached 96.79 only after apps/_shared/pending-overlay-law.test.ts landed in the same change; notes/logic.ts and agenda/logic.ts had NO test at all before it, and now measure 82.30 and 89.87. Deliberately NOT seeded: apps/_shared/placement-registry.ts and apps/_shared/pending-projections.ts (module-scope const tables — `ignoreStatic` discards their mutants, so they score 0 and say nothing), apps/mobile src/lib/notification-model.ts (57.14 local, 24 of 98 mutants never executed by its own suite) and src/lib/phone-link-parse.ts (60.71 local, the base64url transport decode unasserted), and apps/_shared/untrusted.ts — its only suite (src/untrusted-rendering.test.ts) runs under jsdom, and Stryker's vitest runner dry-runs a jsdom project as "No tests were executed", so it cannot defend a seed until a node-side suite exists.
approvedDeviation: #801 remaps mutation seed/floor ids from retired package names onto packages/core/src/{protocol,blob,time} and packages/server{/src/engine,/src/automation,/src/acp}; every numeric floor is unchanged. CI Stryker on PR #709 run 30901194404 measured packages/design at 74.30% (css 63.92 / tile 72.73 / typography 96.08). Prior 93 floor was the design-tokens-only seed (css-properties alone ~96%). Re-seeded to 71 (~3pt under the CI measurement), matching the CI-linux reseed pattern in this file's header for backup/blueprints. #725 seeds packages/model-runtime at 80 from an 83.00 measured score.
